post_content:
I think Data Scientists need to decide they wish to go depth or breadth. I
earlier thought I need to be a math expert to be a good Data Scientist.
Getting to know too much math would leave very little time to build better
applications. Let the PhDs worry about the math. You build innovative
applications to solve real world problems. More than Data Scientists we need
to be problem solvers! hashtag#datascience hashtag#problemsolvers
